description: email.rs handle_email_parse and handle_email_get both build body_prop_set (HashSet<&str> from bodyProperties) once before the per-blob/per-email loop. This is the correct pattern — building it inside the loop would be O(n*m) where n=emails and m=body properties. Explicitly noted with a comment referencing the issue (P2 e53.30).
title: body_prop_set built once before per-blob/per-email loop
